bottom_line: State-linked cyber intrusion into energy grid control systems triggers mandatory incident reporting and infrastructure hardening requirements.
what_changed: CISA issued emergency directive after confirming state-linked intrusion into operational technology networks at multiple US energy utilities.
why_it_matters: Shifts cyber risk from IT to OT domain; utilities face compliance deadlines for network segmentation and incident reporting.
main_uncertainty: Full scope of compromise unknown; attribution to specific state actor is assessed with moderate confidence.

scenarios.name: Contained incident
scenarios.description: Intrusion isolated to reconnaissance; no operational impact.

scenarios.name: Operational disruption
scenarios.description: Attacker deploys destructive payload; grid segment offline.

watch_next: Cyber insurance premium adjustments for energy sector
